REQ-3-1-1#audit-1: Formula entered in grid commits by clicking another cell
REQ-3-1-1#audit-2: Rejected commit keeps original value and dependent results
REQ-3-1-3#audit-1: Single-cell range copy does not expand to adjacent data
REQ-3-2-1#audit-1: Cut into rejecting validation leaves source and target unchanged
REQ-3-2-2#audit-1: Undo and redo restore dependent formula results

claims.quote: Cells support text, numbers, boolean-like values, date text, and formulas beginning with an equals sign. Pressing Enter or clicking another cell commits the change; pressing Escape cancels an uncommitted change.
claims.gap: Existing tests commit edits only with Enter/Escape and enter formulas only through the formula bar; no test enters a formula through the grid's inline editor and commits by clicking another cell.

claims.quote: If a commit fails, an error is displayed, the grid and formula bar continue to show the last successful value or formula, and dependent results remain unchanged.
claims.gap: No test attempts a rejected cell commit and verifies that the value, formula-bar content, and dependent formula results all stay at their last successful state.

claims.quote: Subsequent range operations use exactly this rectangle and must not implicitly expand to adjacent existing data.
claims.gap: Selection tests verify ARIA state and persistence but never perform a range operation to prove an operation does not expand the selected rectangle to adjacent existing cells.

claims.quote: The source range, target range, and affected formulas must either all update and persist after refresh or all remain in their original state; when a target 0-to-100 numeric validation rule rejects the operation, the page displays "Please enter a number from 0 to 100".
claims.gap: The existing validation rejection test copies into an invalid target; no test verifies that a cut into a rejecting target leaves the source range un-cleared and both source and target unchanged.

claims.quote: Undo restores the grid values, original formulas, row/column structure, rule ranges, pivot-result validity, and calculation results from before the operation; consecutive undo operations restore changes in reverse order, and redo reapplies the complete operation that was just undone.
claims.gap: Undo/redo tests cover only literal cell values and row insertion; none verifies that dependent calculation results and original formulas are restored by undo and reapplied by redo.

claims.quote: equal sort keys preserve their original relative order, and entire records move together by row
claims.gap: Only unique sort keys are tested; no test establishes stable ordering for equal sort keys or that whole records stay together for tied keys.

claims.quote: comma-separated items are trimmed of leading and trailing spaces
claims.gap: Allowed values are only tested without surrounding spaces, so trimming of comma-separated dropdown items is unverified.

claims.quote: deleting removes the constraint, and either successful operation closes the dialog without changing existing cell values
claims.gap: The delete test changes A2 to West immediately after deleting and never asserts the existing cell values survived the delete itself.

claims.quote: When SUM or AVERAGE is applied to a value field with no parseable numbers, "Value field requires numeric values" is displayed, the old result is preserved, and the source worksheet is not modified
claims.gap: Only SUM is tested against a nonnumeric value field; AVERAGE on nonnumeric values is not covered, nor is source-worksheet preservation after that failure.
